title: Stasis No Reanimation
description: A surreal fantasy scene features three fairies swirling around a glowing orange vortex inside an ornate black mirror. In the foreground, three cats sit on pink cushions: an orange tabby, a grey cat, and a black cat wearing a checkered cape and holding a glowing orb. A green armored knight casts a spell from the right while a giant praying mantis perches atop the mirror.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy painting shows three glowing fairies with blue wings dancing around a swirling orange vortex of light inside a large ornate black mirror. In front, three cats sit on pink patterned pillows: an orange tabby, a grey cat, and a black cat in a black and white checkered cape holding a pink orb. To the right a green armored knight casts a spell with purple energy. A giant green praying mantis sits on top of the mirror. The background has a red sun, purple stormy sky, distant castle on a hill, desert dunes, pink flowers, open books, and floating bubbles. A wooden sign reads 'STASIS NO REANIMATION'.
